result.description:
Salary Range: $67,510 to $72,000
Location: Darwin / Batchelor, NT

About Us:
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer:
We are supporting a reliable cleaning services business (ABN 19 104 515 123) based in Darwin and surrounding areas, operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, aged care, and Airbnb cleaning. The business is known for quality service, attention to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction. They are seeking a Cleaner / Commercial Housekeeper to join their growing team, offering stable employment, varied worksites, and a supportive work environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Clean and service guest rooms and common areas to schedule and site standards (sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, dusting, spot-cleaning).
- Make beds; change linen; restock towels and amenities (where applicable to site).
- Clean and sanitise bathrooms, kitchens and high-touch surfaces; replenish consumables.
- Empty and segregate waste; restock housekeeping trolleys and storerooms and handling lost property per policy.
- Manage basic stock levels and coordinate safe handling of cleaning chemicals; keep SDS current and accessible.
- Liaise with site contacts on service requirements and report maintenance or WHS hazards promptly.
- Operate equipment safely (e.g., commercial vacuums, microfibre/steam cleaners, pressure/steam equipment where trained).
- Adhering to cleaning schedules, room checklists and brand standards; using chemicals and equipment safely.

Selection Criteria:
1. Housekeeping proficiency: recent experience across hotel rooms and/or other commercial premises; strong eye for detail and presentation.
2. WHS & chemical safety: knowledge of safe work practices and SDS-guided chemical use.
3. Time management: ability to meet room/area turnaround targets and follow run sheets/checklists.
4. Communication: clear, courteous communication with clients, guests and team members; accurate incident/maintenance reporting.
5. Equipment skills: competent with standard housekeeping tools and commercial machines (training provided where required).
6. Quality standards: consistent delivery to brand/site standards; effective self-checks and sign-offs.
7. Flexibility: capacity to work shifts, some weekends/public holidays, and rotate across multiple Darwin sites.

Required Experience and Qualifications:
- 1 to 2+ years relevant commercial housekeeping/cleaning experience (multi-site preferred).
- Understanding of Commercial Cleaner task scope; safe chemical handling and WHS awareness.
- Full working rights in Australia
- Formal qualifications are not mandatory; on-the-job training evidence is valued.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and safety-minded Cleaner / Commercial Housekeeper to join us and help deliver high-standard cleaning and housekeeping services.

To apply, please submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the Cleaner / Commercial Housekeeper role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a reliable and growing cleaning services business that values quality, care, safety, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications close: 04 Aug 2026

Responsibilities
•	Utilize diagnostic software and electronic scanning tools to identify malfunctions within vehicle systems and verify component performance. 
•	Carry out routine vehicle servicing, including fluid replacements, system lubrication, and calibration adjustments to maintain efficiency and meet emissions standards. 
•	Conduct performance evaluations by running engines and mechanical systems post-repair to confirm reliability and proper operation. 
•	Consult technical documentation and manufacturer guidelines while restoring or substituting damaged components within mechanical assemblies. 
•	Disassemble major vehicle units such as powertrains, gearboxes, and steering systems to inspect internal elements for wear or damage. 
•	Reconstruct and reinstall engine systems and related parts following completion of repairs or part replacements. 
•	Troubleshoot both electrical circuits and mechanical assemblies to determine the root causes of operational failures.

About Big Michaels Fruit & Vegetables

Big Michael's Fruit & Vegetables is a Wholesale provider to Retail stores, Restaurants, Cafe's, Clubs etc.



Key Responsibilities

The Retail Buyer will be responsible for selecting, purchasing and coordinating the supply of fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce for the business’s retail, wholesale, hospitality and export customers.

Monitor sales data, customer orders, stock levels and product movement to identify purchasing requirements.

Study fresh produce market conditions, seasonal availability, supplier information, pricing trends and supply shortages.

Select and purchase fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce from farmers, growers, wholesalers and market suppliers.

Inspect, compare and assess produce before purchase, including freshness, quality, grading, size, shelf life and suitability for resale or export.

Negotiate purchase prices, quantities, delivery schedules, payment terms, promotional arrangements and supply conditions with suppliers.

Compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability, delivery capacity, freight costs, seasonal availability and consistency of supply.

Prepare buying plans based on customer demand, retail and wholesale orders, budget requirements, seasonal supply and export needs.

Anticipate consumer demand and determine the quantity, quality and variety of produce to be purchased.

Liaise with management regarding long-term purchasing plans, pricing strategies, product promotions and seasonal sales campaigns.

Recommend retail, wholesale and export pricing based on purchase costs, freight costs, market demand, wastage risk and profit margins.

Coordinate product range, promotional stock allocation and merchandising/display strategies with retail and operations staff.

Maintain strong supplier relationships with farmers, growers, wholesalers, market suppliers and transport providers.

Source produce suitable for hospitality customers and export supply, including produce with appropriate freshness, quality, shelf life and transport timing.

Respond to supply disruptions, price increases or poor seasonal availability by identifying alternative suppliers or substitute products.

Work with internal staff to ensure purchased produce is properly received, recorded, quality checked, stored and allocated.

Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier terms, price comparisons, delivery commitments and stock planning information.

Prepare supplier comparison reports, seasonal market updates, purchasing recommendations and stock movement reports.

Travel as required to farms, wholesale markets, supplier premises and regional distribution areas to inspect produce and assess market conditions.



Qualifications and Experience

AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV

At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal training

Relevant qualification in business, retail, supply chain, purchasing, agriculture, fresh produce, food distribution or a related field; and/or

Relevant practical experience in retail buying, fresh produce buying, wholesale purchasing or supply chain purchasing. Minimum 12 months of recent work experience.



Skills and Competencies.

Strong knowledge of fresh produce, seasonality, quality standards and pricing fluctuations.

Strong negotiation skills with farmers, growers, wholesalers and suppliers.

Ability to analyse sales data, customer demand, stock levels and product movement.

Ability to compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability and delivery capacity.

Understanding of pricing margins, freight costs, promotional planning and wastage risk.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Strong planning, reporting, research and organizational skills.

Ability to travel regularly across metropolitan and regional locations.

Ability to make commercially sound purchasing decisions.
